# Ensemble probabilities gateway answer

`probabilities-2026-11-18.json` is a real answer of the vigie-meteo gateway (`GET /v1/probabilities?lat=50.63&lon=3.06`, Lille), given on
2026-11-18 at about 11:30 UTC from the two runs that the gateway had downloaded from Météo-France: the PE-AROME run of 03:00 UTC
(`pearome/1.0`, 15 windows of three hours that were not yet past) and the PE-ARPEGE run of 06:00 UTC (`pearpege/1.0`, 35 members, 4 windows of
24 hours). Nothing was edited by hand.
